with the input.

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

4. End every interaction with exactly one required puzzle-action JSON object on the final line. A demo request is itself the action; tool calls do not request demos or submit answers. def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate complete zero divider rows and columns. The demos show divider
    # lines change to color 2, while all other cells remain unchanged.
    full_rows = {r for r in range(h) if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r])}
    full_cols = {c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h))}
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] == 0 and (r in full_rows or c in full_cols) else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
